description: AstroLogistics team from Barranquilla. Passionate about space, logistics & Earth data. Skills: data analysis & creativity. Seeking coders & designers to build a real impact solution.
summary: Heat map of Barranquilla using NASA POWER data to find the hottest zones and propose cool roofs and more trees to protect people from heat.
details: SpaceChain Barranquilla Heat Watch. Using NASA POWER data from Jan 1 to Nov 14, 2025, we found the hottest day was March 24, 2025 with 33.75°C. We created a heat map and propose cool roofs, more trees, and green corridors where heat hits hardest. Less heat, more life
